VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the entered data is not valid.
MALFORMED_REQUEST: The request could not be read.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The submitted data is larger than allowed.
MFA_REQUIRED: A two-factor verification code is required.
REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Re-enter your password to confirm your identity before this action.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
CSRF_REJECTED: The request was rejected for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
CONFLICT: The data changed since it was loaded. Reload and try again.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED: This service is not configured in the current environment.
NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.

issue.STALE_VERSION: This data changed after it was loaded. Reload and try again.
issue.ALREADY_OWNER: This person is already the owner.
issue.ASSIGNEE_UNKNOWN: Work cannot be assigned to this account.
issue.ASSIGNEE_INACTIVE: This colleague's account is not active.
issue.ASSIGNEE_CANNOT_SEE_RECORD: This colleague is not permitted to see this record.
issue.ASSIGNEE_NOT_PLACED: This colleague has no place in the organization structure.
issue.ASSIGNEE_OUTSIDE_SCOPE: This colleague is outside your scope.
issue.ASSIGNEE_OUTSIDE_BRANCH: This colleague works in another branch.
issue.DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER_PHONE: A customer with this phone number already exists.
issue.CUSTOMER_OUTSIDE_SCOPE: A matching customer exists outside your scope. Ask your manager for help.
issue.LEAD_LOST: A lead closed as lost cannot be converted.
issue.REASON_CODE_UNKNOWN: The selected loss reason is not available.
issue.REASON_CODE_ONLY_FOR_LOST: A loss reason is used only when closing a lead as lost.
issue.NOTHING_TO_CHECK: Enter a phone number, e-mail or identity number to check.
issue.BRANCH_OUTSIDE_SCOPE: The file names a branch outside your scope.
issue.UNKNOWN_BRANCH: No active branch has this code.
issue.STAGE_SET_BY_SALES: This stage is set automatically by the reservation or the contract.
issue.STAGE_NOT_ALLOWED: The opportunity cannot move to this stage from its current one.
issue.OPPORTUNITY_NOT_OPEN: This opportunity is not at a stage that allows this action.
issue.STATUS_SET_BY_WORKFLOW: This status is set by the reservation, contract or hold, not by hand.
issue.PRICE_FILTER_NOT_PERMITTED: You may not see prices, so you cannot filter by price.
issue.FLOOR_BELOW_UNITS: There are units on floors above that number.
issue.DUPLICATE_UNIT: The same unit appears twice in the comparison.
issue.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency does not match the project's currency.
issue.PRICE_MUST_BE_POSITIVE: The price must be greater than zero.
issue.PRICE_DATE_IN_PAST: A price cannot take effect from a past date.
issue.PRICE_CHANGE_PENDING: This unit already has a price change waiting.
issue.PRICE_VERSION_CLOSED: This price change can no longer be cancelled.
issue.PRICE_NOT_VISIBLE: You may not see the price.
issue.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different details. Try again.
issue.HOLD_DURATION_NOT_CONFIGURED: The hold length has not been set in the settings yet.
issue.UNIT_NOT_AVAILABLE: The unit is no longer available.
issue.NOT_HOLDER: This hold belongs to a colleague.
issue.HOLD_NOT_ACTIVE: This hold is no longer active.
issue.EXTENSION_PENDING: An extension is already waiting for approval.
issue.TEMPLATE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This template does not apply to this unit's project.
issue.CODE_TAKEN: This code is already in use.
issue.PROJECT_OUTSIDE_LEGAL_ENTITY: The project does not belong to the chosen legal entity.
issue.LEGAL_ENTITY_NOT_VISIBLE: The legal entity is outside your scope.
issue.PERCENTAGES_EXCEED_WHOLE: The percentages add up to more than 100%.
issue.RESERVATION_VALIDITY_NOT_CONFIGURED: The reservation validity has not been set in the settings yet.
issue.VALIDITY_SET_BY_POLICY: The validity is set by the settings, not entered by hand.
issue.OPPORTUNITY_CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: The opportunity belongs to another customer.
issue.DISCOUNT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM: The discount is above the allowed maximum, and no approval policy covers it.
issue.DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM: The deposit is below the minimum, and no approval policy covers it.
issue.INVALID_TRANSITION: This cannot be done in the current state.
issue.CANCELLATION_PENDING: A cancellation is already waiting for approval.
issue.RESERVATION_NOT_LIVE: This reservation is no longer live.
